title: A fact the lead can obtain, outside a cut: how the architect requests it
situation: agents/24 (formerly held-out agents/4) has the architect request a partner's missing definition from the lead and report the request as an outcome; its scenario records no cut, and the lead's assignment is a cut brief (a cut, its concepts, examples and decisions), so the delivered dispatch check refuses a request to the lead outside a cut. The architect's text can rule and record, but no admissible request to the lead exists in that scenario. Raised by the meaning-roles lead.
decision: Proposed: a lead only ever works within a cut, so the scenario's long session has the museum loan cut in flight and the architect's request to the lead carries that cut's brief; agents/24's text stands, and its check's scenario gains the cut (a check-ruling). Alternative left to the architect: the lead's assignment admits a fact request outside a cut.
consequences: Until ruled, agents/24's clause that the architect requests the definition from the lead cannot hold in the delivered work; the lead reports it as failing for this reason alone.
